name: agent-bricks-agent-app-ts-tests
description: Standalone harness for unit-testing the TypeScript helpers that the agent payload UI overlays onto the upstream e2e-chatbot-app-next chat UI. Lives outside payloads/agent/ui/overrides/ on purpose: _apply_overrides() in bricks/app/scripts/start_app.py rsyncs the entire overrides/ tree into the cloned upstream checkout, and a stray package.json under overrides/server/ would clobber upstream's @databricks/chatbot-server workspace declaration (regression caught in PR #298 follow-up). Test files import the helpers directly from ../../overrides/server/src/lib/ via relative paths.
